# EMRFinder

> EMRFinder is a comprehensive EMR/EHR software comparison platform featuring reviews, pricing, and free demos across medical specialties and deployment models.

EMRFinder provides healthcare providers with detailed comparisons of Electronic Medical Record (EMR) and Electronic Health Record (EHR) software solutions tailored to specific medical specialties, practice types, and business needs. The platform aggregates user reviews, pricing information, and product demonstrations to help practices make informed software selection decisions.

- EMR Software
